types.label: Curve
types.hint: пропущены обязательные поля (name и points или x+y)

template.code:
func fn$(x) = sin(x) * 3;
draw Function { name = "gr$"; f = "fn$" }

func sf$(x, y) = x*x + y*y - 9;
draw Surface { name = "srf$"; type = heightfield; f = "sf$"; mode = contour; levels = 8 }
template.code3:
func sf$(x, y) = sin(x) * cos(y);
draw Surface3D { name = "srf$"; type = parametric; x = "u"; y = "sf$(u, v)"; z = "v"; umin = -4; umax = 4; vmin = -4; vmax = 4; grid = 30 }

template.code3: draw Trajectory3D { name = "trj$"; P = "-y"; Q = "x"; R = "0.1"; start = (3, 0, 0); steps = 400; dt = 0.02 }

types.label: draw Distribution
types.hint: пропущено обязательное поле (name) или некорректные параметры распределения (type — normal/binomial/poisson/uniform/exponential)

template.code: draw Distribution { name = "dst$"; type = normal; mu = 0; sigma = 1 }

new Point { name = "T$"; pos = (2, 1) }
draw Trace { name = "trc$"; point = T$ }

func rg$(x, y) = x*x + y*y - 9;
draw Region { name = "reg$"; f = "rg$"; op = "<"; rangeX = 6; rangeY = 6 }

list cd$ = [3, 5, 2, 6, 4];
draw Chart { name = "ch$"; type = bar; data = cd$ }

list td$ = ["корень", ["A", ["A1"], ["A2"]], ["B"]];
draw Tree { name = "tree$"; data = td$ }

list tb$ = [["x", "y"], [1, 2], [2, 4]];
draw Table { name = "tab$"; data = tb$ }
draw Complex { name = "cx$"; f = "z^2 - 1"; mode = domain }
draw Hyperbolic { name = "hyp$"; model = disk; radius = 5 }

func bf$(r, x) = r * x * (1 - x);
draw Bifurcation { name = "bif$"; f = "bf$"; rmin = 2.5; rmax = 4 }

func cw$(x) = 3.2 * x * (1 - x);
draw Cobweb { name = "cob$"; f = "cw$"; x0 = 0.2 }
draw Automaton { name = "aut$"; type = elementary; rule = 30 }

list vs$ = [[-3, -2], [2, -1], [0, 3], [4, 2]];
draw Voronoi { name = "vor$"; sites = vs$; mode = voronoi }

list fp$ = [[3, 0], [0, 3], [-3, 0], [0, -3]];
draw Fourier { name = "fou$"; path = fp$; terms = 16 }
